app.name: School Social Hub
app.tagline: Your school's photos, safely organized, every child included, and posted professionally in minutes.

common.notConfigured: The app isn't connected to its database yet. Add the Supabase settings to finish setup.

login.title: Sign in
login.linkError: That link has expired or was already used. Sign in or request a new one.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.error: Couldn't create the account. Check the email and try a longer password.
signup.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it on this device to continue.

onboarding.title: Set up your school
onboarding.intro: You'll be the school admin. You can invite your staff next.
onboarding.error: Couldn't create the school. Check the names and try again.

staff.title: Staff
staff.inviteHint: Create a link and send it by WhatsApp or email. It works once, for that email, for 14 days.
staff.inviteError: Couldn't create the invite. Check the email address.

invite.title: You're invited
invite.signInFirst: Sign in or create an account with {email} to accept.
invite.expired: This invite has expired. Ask the school admin for a new link.
invite.used: This invite has already been used.
invite.wrongEmail: You're signed in as {email}, but this invite is for another address. Sign out and use the invited email.
invite.error: Couldn't accept the invite. Ask the school admin for a new link.

upload.title: Upload photos
upload.notePlaceholder: For example: Grade 4 science fair, volcano projects
upload.optedOut: Some students in these photos must not be posted (their parents said no)
upload.chooseHint: From your phone's camera roll or your computer. Location data is removed.

library.title: Photo library
library.eventError: Couldn't create the event. Check the name and date.
library.aiDone: AI checked {count} photos. The best ones are first.
library.aiDemo: These are sample scores. Add the AI key to get real picks.
library.aiLimit: The free AI plan's limit was reached after {count} photos. Wait a minute and press the button again.
library.aiError: The AI couldn't answer just now. Try again in a minute.
library.aiNotSet: AI key not added yet, so picks and captions use sample results.

students.title: Students and consent
students.importHint: Upload an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file with columns: name, class, parent phone, consent (yes or no). Arabic column names work too.
students.importError: Couldn't read any students from that file. Check it has a name column.
students.error: Something went wrong saving the students. Try again.
students.name: Student name
students.empty: No students yet. Import a class list or add them one by one.
students.unknownRule: Students with no answer are treated as "no" until a parent agrees.

editor.title: Edit photo
editor.saved: Saved. Posts will use the edited photo.
editor.error: Couldn't load or save the photo. Try again.
editor.originalKept: The original photo is always kept.

portal.linksHint: Send a link to a photographer or agency. They upload straight into this event, without an account.
portal.label: Photographer or agency name
portal.chooseHint: Up to 30 at a time. Web-sized copies are made on your device.
portal.closed: This link has expired or was revoked. Ask the school for a new one.
portal.invalid: This upload link isn't valid any more. Ask the school for a new one.
portal.title: Send photos to {school}
portal.privacy: Photos go only to this school's private library. Location data is removed.

posts.createError: Couldn't create the post. Tick at least one photo that isn't marked not for posting.
posts.title: Posts and approvals
posts.howTo: Make a post from the photo library. It goes draft, review, approved, then scheduled or published.

errors.checks: Fix the items marked ⛔ first. Your changes were saved.
errors.when: Choose a date and time first.
errors.signoff: This post needs sign-off from the principal or school admin.
errors.locked: Published posts can't be deleted here.
errors.server: Publishing isn't set up on the server yet (service key missing).

posts.aiDone: Captions written. Read them and change anything before sending for review.
posts.aiDemo: These are sample captions. Add the AI key for real ones.
posts.sensitive: Sensitive post (needs the principal or admin to sign off), for example a child's achievement with their name, health, or a special event

check.optedOut: {count, plural, one {# photo is} other {# photos are}} marked not for posting. Remove them.
check.aiSensitive: AI thinks {count, plural, one {# photo is} other {# photos are}} sensitive. Remove them or tick "Sensitive post" so the principal checks.
check.studentName: The caption names a student ({names}). Remove the name.
check.classConsent: {count} students in {className} have no consent. Check no one of them appears in the photos.
check.igRatio: {count, plural, one {# photo has} other {# photos have}} a shape Instagram won't accept. Edit it to square or portrait.
check.igTen: Instagram shows only the first 10 photos.
check.aiIssues: AI found quality issues in {count, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}}.

posts.notConnected: Facebook and Instagram aren't connected yet. The admin connects them in school settings.
posts.needsSignoff: This post is sensitive, so the principal or admin approves it.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.hint: Scheduled and published posts, in {timeZone} time.

settings.title: School settings
settings.brandVoiceHint: For example: warm and proud, mention our values of respect and curiosity, no slang.
settings.requireSignoff: Every post needs the principal or admin to sign off (not only sensitive ones)

metaResult.error: Couldn't connect. Try again, and accept all permissions on the Facebook screen.
metaResult.nopages: Your Facebook account doesn't manage any Pages. Use the account that is admin of the school's Page.
metaResult.missing: The Meta app keys aren't added on the server yet.

settings.noInstagram: no Instagram business account linked to this Page
settings.connectHint: Sign in with the Facebook account that manages the school's Page. Its linked Instagram business account is connected too.

setupItems.database: Server key for publishing and photographer links
setupItems.ai: AI key (Gemini) for picks and captions
setupItems.meta: Meta app keys for Facebook and Instagram

activity.title: Activity log
activity.hint: Everything important that happens in your school's account, newest first.

actions.photo.flagged: marked a photo not for posting
actions.post.reject: asked for changes to a post
actions.post.draft: moved a post back to draft
actions.post.published: post went live on social media
